title.en: Clear deployment warnings and stale release work
title.zh: 清理部署告警与陈旧发布任务

purpose.en: Close the current SmartLingo release cycle with no active deployment error, warning annotation, or stale queued release while preserving immutable audit history.
purpose.zh: 在保留不可变审计历史的同时，完成当前 SmartLingo 发布周期，清除活动中的部署错误、告警注释与陈旧排队发布。

en: Move both SmartLingo workflows to the current Node 24-native GitHub Actions majors.
Remove the repeated attempt to create an R2 bucket that already exists and previously printed a tolerated red Cloudflare error on every deployment.
Keep dependency installation, D1 validation, production builds, and Project release writes free of known non-actionable warning output while retaining fail-closed behavior.

Update the production framework, React runtime, Vinext/Vite toolchain, Cloudflare integration, webinar SDK, spreadsheet parser, and vulnerable transitive implementations so dependency advisories are removed.
Add an executable workflow contract that prevents the removed warning and tolerated-error patterns from returning.
zh: 把两个 SmartLingo 工作流升级到当前原生使用 Node 24 的 GitHub Actions 主版本。
移除每次部署都重复创建既有 R2 bucket、并输出被容忍的 Cloudflare 红色错误的步骤。
清除依赖安装、D1 验证、生产构建与 Project 发布写入中的已知非操作性告警输出，同时继续保持失败即停止。
更新生产框架、React 运行时、Vinext/Vite 工具链、Cloudflare 集成、网络研讨会 SDK、表格解析器与存在漏洞的传递式实现，清除依赖安全告警。
新增可执行工作流契约，防止已移除的告警与容忍错误模式回归。

en: SmartLingo GitHub Actions, the reviewed Vite client-chunk ceiling, the pinned Wrangler toolchain, release metadata, and continuous route preflight.
Learning behavior, member records, Clerk configuration, D1 schemas and content, R2 objects, colleges, commerce, AI providers, and other sites remain unchanged.
zh: 涉及 SmartLingo GitHub Actions、经审核的 Vite 客户端分块上限、固定 Wrangler 工具链、发布元数据与持续路由预检。
学习行为、会员记录、Clerk 配置、D1 结构与内容、R2 对象、学院、交易、AI 提供方及其他站点保持不变。

en: Upgrade checkout, setup-node, and route-evidence upload actions to v7 and pin Wrangler 4.126.0.

Upgrade Next.js to 16.3.3, React to 19.2.8, Vinext to 1.0.0-beta.8, Vite to 8.2.2, Cloudflare's Vite plugin to 1.54.0, RealtimeKit to 2.0.2, and SheetJS to the official 0.20.3 distribution; force vulnerable legacy UUID, esbuild, and tmp transitive dependencies to compatible fixed releases.
Make npm install output error-only in CI and suppress only Node's expected experimental SQLite notice during the dedicated migration replay step.
Set the runner's Git default branch before checkout so repository initialization is deterministic and does not emit the legacy branch-name hint.
Write the small Project release statement through Wrangler's command path instead of the bulk-file path that emits a database-availability warning.

Set a reviewed 2,500 kB client-chunk warning ceiling; the existing route-scoped semantic vocabulary catalog remains below it and future growth above it still warns. Disable only Rolldown's non-actionable per-plugin timing notice while retaining the bounded-build timeout.

Document SmartLingo's intentional full-page navigation boundary after authentication, payment, enrollment, and realtime-session mutations so the new framework advisory does not misclassify required session refreshes.
Use native-loader-compatible Vite imports and replace the legacy ambiguous middleware matcher with explicit twelve-language and API route matchers; static assets remain outside Clerk middleware.
zh: 将 checkout、setup-node 与路由证据上传 action 升级至 v7，并固定 Wrangler 4.126.0。
将 Next.js 升级到 16.3.3、React 升级到 19.2.8、Vinext 升级到 1.0.0-beta.8、Vite 升级到 8.2.2、Cloudflare Vite 插件升级到 1.54.0、RealtimeKit 升级到 2.0.2，并使用 SheetJS 官方 0.20.3 发行包；把存在漏洞的旧传递式 UUID、esbuild 与 tmp 依赖锁定到兼容修复版本。
在 CI 中只输出 npm 安装错误，并且仅在专用迁移重放步骤关闭 Node 预期的实验性 SQLite 提示。
在检出代码前设置运行器的 Git 默认分支，使仓库初始化保持确定性且不再输出旧分支命名提示。
通过 Wrangler command 路径写入小型 Project 发布语句，不再使用会输出数据库可用性告警的批量文件路径。
设置经审核的 2,500 kB 客户端分块告警上限；现有路由专用语义词汇目录低于该值，未来超出仍会触发告警。仅关闭 Rolldown 不具可操作性的逐插件计时提示，并继续保留有界构建超时。
记录 SmartLingo 在认证、支付、选课与实时会话变更后必须进行完整页面跳转的边界，避免新框架建议规则把必要的会话刷新误判为告警。
采用兼容原生加载器的 Vite 导入格式，并把旧式歧义 middleware matcher 替换为明确的十二语言与 API 路由匹配；静态资源继续不经过 Clerk middleware。

en: Require zero-warning ESLint, TypeScript no-emit, the verified production build, sensitive-data and artifact checks, all repository tests, D1 replay, and shared site policy and architecture contracts.
Require the complete production-and-build dependency audit to report zero advisories and enforce the moderate-or-higher audit gate in every deployment.
Inspect the terminal GitHub run annotations and logs, production route preflight, production Project record, exact deployed commit, and public localized routes after deployment.
Confirm no SmartLingo QA or Recovery task is actively running and reconcile the daily QA automation to the exact new production version.
zh: 要求零告警 ESLint、TypeScript no-emit、经验证的生产构建、敏感信息与产物检查、全仓测试、D1 重放及共享站点政策与架构契约通过。
要求生产与构建依赖的完整安全审计为零告警，并在每次部署中强制执行中危及以上审计门禁。
部署后核对终态 GitHub 运行注释与日志、生产路由预检、生产 Project 记录、精确部署提交及公开本地化路由。
确认没有 SmartLingo QA 或 Recovery 任务正在运行，并把每日 QA 自动化校准到新的精确生产版本。

en: Historical failed, cancelled, blocked, and warning records remain intact as audit evidence; they are not current release blockers.
The daily 03:00 QA schedule remains intentionally active as continuous monitoring and is not an unfinished release task.
zh: 历史失败、取消、受阻及告警记录作为审计证据完整保留；它们不是当前发布阻塞项。
每天 03:00 的 QA 计划按设计继续启用，属于持续监控，不是未完成的发布任务。

en: Keep SmartLingo's isolated GitHub-to-Cloudflare deployment, D1-before-build ordering, Project evidence contract, and 21-day route preflight.
Preserve the user's untracked local files and every Clerk, Cloudflare, AI, media, data, and external-service boundary.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 独立的 GitHub 至 Cloudflare 发布、D1 先于构建顺序、Project 证据契约与 21 天路由预检。
保留用户本地未跟踪文件，以及所有 Clerk、Cloudflare、AI、媒体、数据与外部服务边界。
